findings.message: Acceptance criterion 2 requires the AssertionError message for an 8193-byte template to contain `compress`. The message is "Compress existing rules or move host-specific ones to the project's own rules outside the managed block". A case-sensitive substring check for `compress` does not match it.
findings.paved_road: Use the lowercase word in the message, for example "Template too large: compress existing rules or move host-specific ones to the project's own rules outside the managed block".

findings.message: The boundary test uses `match="[Cc]ompress"`, which accepts the capital-C message. So the test passes even though the message does not contain `compress` as acceptance criterion 2 requires.
findings.paved_road: Change the match to `match="compress"` so the test checks the exact substring the criterion names.
